absorbaholic.trait.absorbent.desc: You hold your breath underwater much longer.
absorbaholic.trait.arctic_fur.desc: You resist freezing and hit harder.
absorbaholic.trait.beacon_blessing.desc: You carry the beacon's Haste, then Speed and Regeneration.
absorbaholic.trait.big_leap.desc: You jump much higher and land safely from higher up.
absorbaholic.trait.blast_proof.desc: Explosions barely hurt or move you.
absorbaholic.trait.blaze_barrage.desc: Sneak and swing at the air to shoot fireballs; fire hurts less.
absorbaholic.trait.blink.desc: Sneak and jump to teleport where you look.
absorbaholic.trait.bouncy.desc: You bounce on landing, jump higher and take less fall damage.
absorbaholic.trait.brute_force.desc: You hit much harder and stand your ground.
absorbaholic.trait.buzz_hover.desc: Press jump in mid-air for short flying bursts.
absorbaholic.trait.carpenter.desc: You break blocks a bit faster.
absorbaholic.trait.cat_presence.desc: Creepers and phantoms keep their distance.
absorbaholic.trait.chorus_hop.desc: Sneak and jump to teleport to a random nearby spot.
absorbaholic.trait.chubby.desc: Extra hearts and a sturdier stance.
absorbaholic.trait.cloud_floater.desc: You weigh less, and sneaking in the air lets you drift down.
absorbaholic.trait.collector.desc: Nearby dropped items fly to you.
absorbaholic.trait.conductor.desc: Lightning barely hurts you and you swing faster.
absorbaholic.trait.controlled_blast.desc: Double-tap sneak to explode without breaking blocks.
absorbaholic.trait.desert_endurance.desc: You get hungry much more slowly.
absorbaholic.trait.diamond_skin.desc: Your skin becomes as hard as diamond armor.
absorbaholic.trait.dolphins_grace.desc: You zoom through water and breathe longer.
absorbaholic.trait.down_to_earth.desc: Knockback pushes you around a little less.
absorbaholic.trait.dragon_flight.desc: You can fly freely, but not while fighting.

absorbaholic.trait.dune_walker.desc: Slowing blocks like soul sand and honey hinder you less.
absorbaholic.trait.echolocation.desc: In the dark, nearby mobs glow for you.
absorbaholic.trait.fang_summoner.desc: Sneak and swing at the air to summon a line of fangs.
absorbaholic.trait.feather_fall.desc: Falls hurt you less, then not at all.

absorbaholic.trait.hide_in_grass.desc: While sneaking, monsters notice you later.

absorbaholic.trait.lucky_foot.desc: Luck favors your loot and fishing.
absorbaholic.trait.magma_blood.desc: Fire and lava hurt you less, then not at all.
absorbaholic.trait.midas_luck.desc: Luck favors your loot and fishing.

absorbaholic.trait.pearl_hopper.desc: Ender pearls hurt you less, then not at all.
absorbaholic.trait.photosynthesis.desc: Standing in sunlight slowly heals you.
absorbaholic.trait.piglin_pal.desc: Piglins treat you as kin, and you hit a bit harder.
absorbaholic.trait.play_dead.desc: When badly hurt, you heal quickly.
absorbaholic.trait.prickly.desc: Melee attackers get pricked; cacti and berry bushes don't hurt.

absorbaholic.trait.reef_rest.desc: Being in water slowly heals you.
